messages:
mika: Quick sync — SakuraCompute (JP SI) asked for an embargoed joint announcement around our Private + Datadog tracing integration. Need checklist: demo video, dashboards, acceptance tests, and a press blurb. Timeline?
leo: +1. We have the tracing hooks in runtime but need a short walkthrough showing OTLP -> Datadog APM flow in VPC setup. Can we aim for assets by next Tue?
jamie: Sales wants the announcement slot for Thu two weeks from now. If engineering can deliver by Tue, marketing can prep.
tara: I can own dashboard screenshots and the smoke demo script. Need access to a Sakura dev VPC and a sample model trace.
mika: @tara I'll request the dev VPC creds from the SI PM today. @leo can you share a minimal OTLP forwarder config so the SI can wire it?
leo: Pasting a tiny example they can copy/paste:```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
leo: Note — they'll need our auth token for trace enrichment, I'll wrap that in the onboarding doc.
tara: For acceptance criteria, propose: 1) traces show request/response spans with model.metadata tags; 2) latency p50/p95 in dashboard; 3) exemplar trace with embedding/span linking to request id. Thoughts?
jamie: Looks good. Also add a short line saying "no customer data in demo recordings" for compliance.
mika: Adding that now. Also marketing asked for two short blurbs: one technical (how tracing helps model ops) and one customer-facing (what benefit SI customers get). Who can draft?
leo: I can draft the technical blurb and attach a tiny diagram.
tara: I'll do the customer-facing blurb — simple plain language.
mika: Awesome. Action items: 
- mika: get SakuraCompute dev creds by EOD today.
- leo: finalize OTLP + token snippet + diagram by EOD tomorrow.
- tara: dashboard screenshots + demo script by next Mon.
- jamie: coordinate announcement slot with marketing once we confirm assets.
(Assigning in thread)
dd-integrations-bot: deploy-checker: deployment pipeline for sakura-integration passed staging smoke (build #452). :white_check_mark:
leo: Nice — staging pass makes timing realistic. If staging holds we can record demo Wed.
jamie: I'll tentatively book Thu two weeks out and mark it "subject to final assets".
mika: Thanks team. I'll post an update here once creds arrive and will ping @tara when infra is ready. :thumbsup:
